name: dependency-watch
title: Dependency watch
description: A recurring audit of the project's dependencies: advisories that stand right now, grouped and ranked, with the smallest upgrade path that clears them. Runs on its own scheduled card — no worktree needed. Put it on the calendar by copying it to ~/.tower/flows (it ships manual so no project is watched without asking).

steps.name: watch
steps.text:
Weekly dependency watch. Work in the project checkout ({{worktreePath}} is empty — this runs on a scheduled card; modify nothing).

Inventory the manifests and lockfiles that exist — npm/pnpm, Cargo, Python, Go, and vendored notices — and run the audit tool each ecosystem ships with (npm audit, cargo audit, pip-audit, osv-scanner), only tools that are installed; skip the rest with a note. For every advisory, check whether the vulnerable code is actually reachable from this project's own source: a dependency flagged but never imported is standing, not urgent.

Write the report to the absolute path `{{reportPath}}`: advisories grouped as reachable / flagged-only / informational (package, installed version → fixed version, severity, exploited-in-the-wild if known), then the upgrade path — the smallest set of version bumps or commands that clears the reachable ones, and what each could break. Fail the stage only for a reachable critical advisory with a known exploit; pass otherwise. Empty and clean are normal, healthy results — say so and pass.
